title: Development and validation of novel inflammatory response-related gene signature for sepsis prognosis.

models.expression_scale_used: z-score of gene expression ('EXP gene ... adjusted by the Z-score')
models.reported_performance: 28-day AUC: GSE65682 training (n=240) 0.866; GSE65682 validation (n=238) 0.858; GSE95233 (n=51) 0.813; C-index 0.73 (training)
models.source_location: Methods (risk score) + Results (formula); read via PMC web page (WebFetch), not local XML

notes: No local full text; extracted from the PMC article page via WebFetch (summarizing model output; formula re-fetched verbatim twice and consistent). Europe PMC reports the article as not open access, so no supplement downloaded. Abstract names only GSE64457/GSE69528 (GSEA sepsis vs healthy) and GSE95233; full text adds GSE65682 (478 patients with 28-d survival, random split 240/238) as modeling cohort. Coefficients from multivariate Cox after univariate Cox + LASSO-Cox in training set. Very high internal AUCs; verify coefficients against the PDF if possible.
